title: GTA 6 Online Multiplayer: Twitch CEO Reckons It Will Land Next Year
description: Rockstar has stayed tight-lipped on GTA 6's multiplayer component, but Twitch's CEO speculates it could launch next year. Here is what we know.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Anticipation Around GTA 6 Multiplayer

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, players around the world are eager to learn more about the future of online play. Given the monumental, long-lasting success of Grand Theft Auto Online in GTA 5, the expectations for a potential successor in GTA 6 are naturally through the roof. Yet, Rockstar has remained very tight-lipped about the multiplayer component of the next entry.

## What We Currently Know From Official Sources

As it stands, Rockstar Games has not yet officially commented on whether it will even launch a dedicated multiplayer mode for GTA 6. According to all current available information, when Grand Theft Auto 6 finally arrives on November 19th, it will only include the single-player campaign. 

## Industry Speculation and Perspectives

Despite the lack of official announcements from the developers, external voices in the gaming and tech industry continue to weigh in. According to reports from Eurogamer, Twitch's CEO has publicly shared a prediction that the game's multiplayer or online component will likely land next year. It is important to note that this remains a speculation rather than an official confirmation from Rockstar Games itself.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's silence on GTA 6's online features is characteristic of their measured marketing approach. While a multiplayer successor feels inevitable given modern gaming trends, focusing entirely on the single-player launch on November 19th is a smart way to ensure core quality. Fans should treat external predictions like the Twitch CEO's with cautious optimism until Rockstar speaks.
